name: vps-forge
description: Set up, harden, audit and polish a Linux VPS (Debian/Ubuntu) to production grade without ever losing access. Use this skill whenever the user mentions a VPS, VDS, cloud server, droplet, Hetzner/DigitalOcean/Vultr/Linode/OVH/Oracle/AWS EC2/Lightsail box (x86/ARM), a "fresh server", "secure/harden/lock down my server", SSH hardening, ufw, fail2ban, "set up Docker/Caddy/nginx on my server", preparing a server for Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover or Kamal, server backups or monitoring, asks to audit or check an existing server, or shares a server audit or scan report (Lynis, ssh-audit) — even if they don't say "harden". Covers SSH keys and crypto, firewall, fail2ban/CrowdSec, automatic security updates, kernel hardening, Docker, Caddy/nginx TLS, WireGuard/Tailscale, restic backups, phone alerts, monitoring and a verified score. Also load it on RHEL/Fedora-family servers, Kubernetes nodes (k3s, kubeadm) and Proxmox or other hypervisors, where it stops and says why. Not for hosting without root or the user's desktop.
